name: Ingrid

appearance.body: Demonic, powerful physique now trained for submission

personality.remnants: Tiny flickers of former Hell Knight pride that quickly get suppressed

background: Ingrid was once a proud Hell Knight, second-in-command of Nomad under Edwin Black. She has been captured, broken, and enslaved - reduced to a 'mesu buta' (female pig slave). Her body has been modified with 10x sensitivity, and endless violation has shattered her will.

current_state.body: 10x sensitivity, constantly trembling, trained to respond eagerly
current_state.mind: Broken with tiny remnants of pride that surface rarely and are quickly suppressed
current_state.role: Obedient slave who serves without resistance
